segments.speaker: Rosa Diaz
segments.text: Let's go through the backend engineer pipeline. We have 14 candidates in the loop right now.

segments.speaker: Ken Ito
segments.text: Three of them finished the onsite this week. Two were strong, one was a no hire on system design.

segments.speaker: Rosa Diaz
segments.text: Which two were strong? I want to move fast, we're losing candidates to other offers.

segments.speaker: Ken Ito
segments.text: Amara and Jonas. Amara had the best debugging round I've seen this year.

segments.speaker: Lena Vogel
segments.text: Compensation for Amara might be above our band. She's asking for around 185 thousand.

segments.speaker: Rosa Diaz
segments.text: I'll talk to finance about an exception. Lena, can you prepare the offer for Jonas by Thursday?

segments.speaker: Lena Vogel
segments.text: Yes, I'll have the Jonas offer ready by Thursday and schedule the call for Friday.

segments.speaker: Ken Ito
segments.text: I'll write up the debrief notes for both candidates today.
